reason: The README describes a DSH settings plugin for configuring Hindsight external memory, managing service routes, controlling session synchronization, and installing the official adapter, so memory-context is the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中配置 Hindsight 外部记忆服务、管理路由与会话同步，并检测或安装官方适配器。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for configuring Hindsight external memory, managing service routes and session synchronization, and detecting or installing the official adapter.

capabilities: Manages Hindsight memory service routing and session-retention settings
Tests configured service endpoints over HTTP
Automatically runs the official Hindsight DSH adapter installer via npx
Writes and backs up DSH configuration files
Audits and removes duplicate plugin registration entries when requested
